description: Approved cross-endpoint APP style presets for Web, PC, Mobile, and Tablet UI generation.

endpoint_guidance.web: Translucent browser dashboard with soft blur panels and native-like side navigation.
endpoint_guidance.pc: macOS-like app frame with glass cards, command controls, and spacious charts.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Stacked native cards, bottom navigation, large tap targets, and restrained labels.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Split panes, larger glass cards, side navigation, and touch-scale charts.

endpoint_guidance.web: Dynamic color sections, rounded containers, expressive tabs, and large controls.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Adaptive desktop shell with colorful panels and responsive grid.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Large rounded cards, dynamic surfaces, clear top app bar, and FAB-like action.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Adaptive two-column layout with dynamic panels and prominent primary action.

endpoint_guidance.web: Light work hub with command bar, sidebar, task lists, and activity cards.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Windows-like command surface with left rail, detail pane, and timeline.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Compact work list, activity cards, and calm blue productivity accents.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Expanded productivity split view with navigation rail, list pane, and detail pane.

endpoint_guidance.web: Clean KPI dashboard with white surfaces, thin borders, tables, and line charts.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Dense but quiet table and chart workspace with precise filters.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Simplified KPI cards, concise lists, clean filters, and one dominant action.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Wider analytics cards, filter rail, compact table region, and readable charts.

endpoint_guidance.web: Dark browser workspace with toolbar, layers/sidebar, inspector cards, and canvas.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Dense panels, central workbench, inspector, tabs, and status bars.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Compact dark panels, quick tools, mini inspector areas, and high-contrast states.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Wide workbench with inspector/sidebar, canvas, timeline, and status cards.

endpoint_guidance.web: Layered glass dashboard over a soft atmospheric backdrop with restrained glow.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Frosted analytics cards, dark translucent layers, and premium dashboard composition.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Stacked translucent cards, dark premium background, readable overlays, and minimal glow.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Translucent split layout with summary cards, detail pane, and premium depth.

endpoint_guidance.web: Pale dashboard with raised/sunken controls, sparse cards, and large tactile inputs.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Spacious tactile control dashboard with low-density cards and soft shadows.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Large tactile controls, sparse content, soft shadows, and clear active states.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Large control tiles, spacious cards, clear selected states, and contrast safeguards.

endpoint_guidance.web: Asymmetric card grid with KPIs, charts, maps, status blocks, and mixed modules.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Large mixed-module dashboard with overview metrics, maps, charts, and tasks.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Stacked bento cards with prioritized metrics and no tiny multi-column details.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Expanded bento grid with more modules while preserving clear hierarchy.

endpoint_guidance.web: Thick borders, saturated blocks, visible grid, oversized buttons, and direct labels.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Bold desktop command board with explicit tabs and thick bordered panels.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Chunky cards, oversized buttons, thick outlines, and very clear hierarchy.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Loud modular board with clear grid tracks and large interaction zones.

endpoint_guidance.web: Friendly dashboard with puffy cards, reward widgets, soft 3D accents, and progress.
endpoint_guidance.pc: 3D learning workspace with lesson cards, rewards, and approachable controls.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Large friendly cards, simple progress, reward objects, mascot accents, and bottom navigation.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Activity planner with reward panel, progress cards, friendly objects, and wide touch zones.

endpoint_guidance.web: Textured panel app with material metaphors, realistic controls, and clear spacing.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Hardware-like desktop console with realistic surfaces and visible physical controls.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Realistic controls used sparingly with large tap targets and minimal clutter.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Material-rich tablet console with carefully spaced panels and controls.

endpoint_guidance.web: Image-led story grid with headline hierarchy and curated sections.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Editorial reading workspace with hero image, story columns, and content rail.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Image-led article cards, large headlines, vertical stream, and simple reading controls.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Magazine split view with hero imagery, story rail, body preview, and curated sections.

endpoint_guidance.web: Elegant discovery portal with refined surfaces, premium photography, and sparse CTAs.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Refined booking or product workstation with dark elegant panels and minimal actions.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Premium booking/discovery flow with dark or neutral surfaces and sparse CTAs.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Immersive product/service cards, refined split layout, and elegant action area.

endpoint_guidance.web: Finance dashboard with account overview, charts, alerts, and transactions.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Portfolio workstation with watchlists, risk notices, transaction tables, and charts.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Account summary, finance cards, transaction list, risk notices, and precise CTAs.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Expanded portfolio charts, alerts, transaction detail, and account summary side by side.

endpoint_guidance.web: Calm care dashboard with appointments, care status, and readable progress.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Care workspace with patient or wellness records, schedule, and summary cards.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Daily care card, appointment reminder, simple progress check, and reassuring tone.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Split care dashboard with schedule, metrics, notes, and calming hierarchy.

styles.name: Education Playful

endpoint_guidance.web: Course progress hub with modules, badges, and friendly illustrations.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Learning workspace with lesson list, activity board, rewards, and analytics.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Lesson path, progress meter, badges, friendly illustration, and one next-step action.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Classroom activity board with lesson detail, reward area, and progress overview.

avoid: overly childish UI for adult learners

endpoint_guidance.web: Product grid with filters, offer strip, cart summary, ratings, and product hierarchy.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Catalog management or shopping desktop with product grid, filters, detail pane, and cart.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Product detail, gallery, price, variants, ratings, cart, and high-clarity checkout CTA.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Browsing plus checkout split with filters, product grid, and cart/detail panel.

endpoint_guidance.web: Feed stream, creator cards, side navigation, media previews, reactions, and balanced density.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Creator desktop feed with content grid, feed column, reactions, messages, and side navigation.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Feed-first layout with media card, reactions, comments, creator profile, and bottom navigation.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Media grid plus conversation/detail pane while keeping creator context visible.

endpoint_guidance.web: Chat pane, context cards, generated artifact preview, source area, and prompt composer.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Copilot workspace with prompt editor, context list, artifacts, citations, and output preview.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Prompt composer, conversation cards, suggestions, source chips, and compact artifact preview.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Context pane, chat pane, artifact preview, and citation/source panel in a touch grid.

endpoint_guidance.web: Missions, XP, rewards, streaks, campaign panels, leaderboards, and measurable progress cards.
endpoint_guidance.pc: Mission-control panel with leaderboard, active missions, rewards, and campaign metrics.
endpoint_guidance.mobile: Quests, streak, rewards, XP bar, claim/start action, and compact mission status.
endpoint_guidance.tablet: Event map, rewards board, mission list, progress cards, and leaderboards across a wide canvas.
